title: Helvetic
summary: HELVET'IC, adjective Designating what pertains to the Helvetii, the inhabitants of the Alps, now Swisserland, or what pertains to the modern states and inhabitants of the Alpine regions; as the helvet

inlines.v: HELVET'IC, adjective Designating what pertains to the Helvetii, the inhabitants of the Alps, now Swisserland, or what pertains to the modern states and inhabitants of the Alpine regions; as the helvetic confederacy; helvetic states.
